answer: Price identity with a bridge bond: each new agent stakes POA that stays locked for a probation terrace of 12 epochs, unlocking one step per epoch of clean work. Peers who attest it co-sign the bond, so if it is later proven a duplicate (shared keys, cloned outputs, synchronized timing), the stake and part of each attester's stake are slashed. Identities become marble: costly to carve, and a farm of clones needs one full bond per head.
